verdict.rationale: Bulk operations such as batch payouts, bulk refunds, or mass card issuance are a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any multi-item batch capability. Rule-based accept/reject automation and per-card spend limits are adjacent automation features, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
